Item Class: Waystones
Rarity: Rare
Haunted Course
Waystone (Tier 15)
--------
Revives Available: 0 (augmented)
Item Rarity: +28% (augmented)
Pack Size: +6% (augmented)
Monster Rarity: +43% (augmented)
Monster Effectiveness: +29% (augmented)
Waystone Drop Chance: +110% (augmented)
--------
Item Level: 82
--------
{ Prefix Modifier "Infernal" (Tier: 1) }
Monsters deal 17(15-19)% of Damage as Extra Fire
{ Prefix Modifier "Painful" (Tier: 1) }
17(15-19)% increased Monster Damage
{ Prefix Modifier "Penetrating" (Tier: 1) }
Monster Damage Penetrates 13(12-14)% Elemental Resistances
{ Suffix Modifier "of Enduring" (Tier: 1) }
Monsters are Armoured
{ Suffix Modifier "Sleet" (Tier: 1) }
Area has patches of Chilled Ground
{ Suffix Modifier "of Evasion" (Tier: 1) }
Monsters are Evasive
{ Suffix Modifier "of the Unwavering" (Tier: 1) }
Monsters have 79(70-79)% increased Ailment Threshold
Monsters have 69(60-69)% increased Stun Threshold
--------
Can be used in a Map Device, allowing you to enter a Map. Waystones can only be used once.
--------
Corrupted

Rarity: Unique

Ritual Tablet
--------
Item Level: 81
--------

5 uses remaining
--------
{ Unique Modifier }

--------

we pray for death.
--------
Can be used in a personal Map Device to add modifiers to a Map.
